params.body:
## Why the count was wrong

The warning added in PR 334 ("35 photos have no platform copy yet") is derived from `PlatformPhotoService::missing()`, which treated an own photo as covered only when some platform copy carried its id in `vehicle_photo_id`. Vehicle 21707 is a duplicate of 19735 made with the copy button (S1-10). `OwnStockController::copyPhotos` copied the platform rows verbatim: their `vehicle_photo_id` still pointed at the own photos of 19735 and their `duplicated_from_path` still carried the `19735/` folder. On 21707 every copy existed and none matched: 35 own photos, 35 "missing". Reproduced on a seeded duplicate: 8 own photos with 6 copies shaped like that reported **8 missing** on origin/main, **2** on this branch (the two photos that genuinely have no copy). A press on Save on such a vehicle would have re-created copies that already exist, one remove.bg credit each.

## The two-ended fix

**Root (`copyPhotos`).** The own photos are copied first and return an old-to-new id map; the platform copies are copied with that map so `vehicle_photo_id` points at the own photo of the *new* vehicle, and the folder prefix in `duplicated_from_path` / `duplicated_from_thumbnail_path` is remapped like the other paths. An id not in the map (the own photo was already gone) is left as it was rather than nulled, so the vehicle does not become "unmapped" by copying.

**Existing data (`missing()`).** A copy is matched to an own photo by, in order:

1. `vehicle_photo_id`, when that id is an own photo of this vehicle;
2. otherwise the file name of `duplicated_from_path` (without the vehicle folder), compared with the own photo's file name.

**Which rule wins:** the id. A copy whose id resolves to an own photo of this vehicle is never re-read by path, even if its path names another photo. A copy where neither resolves covers nothing. A copy without an id (partner API, `Photo::createStockListPhotoFromPhoto`) still makes the vehicle unmapped and nothing is created. Nothing that exists is ever re-created.

Other paths that create copies: the photo-tab duplicate button (`ImageController::duplicate_image`) and the service itself already write `vehicle_photo_id` correctly; the partner API leaves it null (known, `unmapped()` bails out). `stocklist:platformfotos` uses the same service and reports the corrected numbers (verified on the seeded duplicate: 8 before, 2 after).

## The button

The warning now carries a control in the shape of "Prijzen invullen" (`ui-field-link`): "De 2 platformkopieën nu aanmaken". It POSTs to `ownvehicle.create.platformPhotos` (`OwnStockController::queuePlatformPhotos`, owner check, 403 otherwise), which runs `PlatformPhotoService::queue()` exactly as saving does and answers with the same `PlatformPhotoOutcome`. The page dispatches that outcome over the existing `flash` channel, so `ui.notify` shows it:

- copies missing, seal open: queues exactly the missing ones, green "2 platformfoto's worden aangemaakt.", the gallery reloads itself (new copies with their spinner, warning gone);
- seal closed (staging): nothing queued, the red "De platformfoto's konden niet aangemaakt worden: de fotoverwerking staat uit in deze omgeving ..." the save path gives;
- nothing missing: no warning and no button; a second press answers `queued: 0` with no message;
- while running the button is disabled and reads "Platformkopieën worden aangemaakt…"; a failed request gives a red notify.

The partial is shared by the Livewire sheet (under `wire:ignore`), the classic edit/create pages and the AJAX gallery refresh, so the handler is plain Alpine + fetch, no Livewire binding; no double quotes inside the attribute (X-96).

## Docs and tests

Rules S2-1.16 (warning + button) and new S2-1.17 (matching order, id wins), note on S1-10.2, finding X-127. Ten new tests in `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest` (duplicate via the real endpoint, legacy-shaped copies, precedence, API-unmapped, button success/sealed/403, tab rendering). `php artisan test --filter='PlatformPhoto|Photo|OwnStock|VehicleForm|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage'`: 87 tests green; full suite 859 tests, only `BuildStampTest` (worktree artifact).
params.title: The platform-copy warning counted wrong and offered no way out
